title: The module does not say which model to use
description: Nothing names a model or effort level. The cost table's $1.86 vs $12.80 comparison can't be interpreted if the runs used different models.
priority: Costs time or weakens the spec
proposed_change: State which model the evidence runs used, and whether the guidance assumes a particular model or effort level.

title: Step 3 cannot be performed as written
description: Names three checks and gives no method for any of them. First step with no prompt, and the change in format is not signalled.
proposed_change: Give a prompt for the mechanical parts, or spell out the method: read each Ticket-labelled criterion against the ticket; open each file named in a Rule label and confirm the rule is there; ask whether a tester could write a test from each criterion without asking a question.

title: Step 4's marker count was read as a target
description: The '22 to 31' figure anchored the reader, and the step does not make clear that it counts clarification markers, not acceptance criteria.
proposed_change: Move the evidence figures out of the instruction. Say plainly that Step 4 reduces the clarification markers, and that the criteria stay.

title: Prompt placeholders are unexplained
description: [list] (Step 4) must be constructed first and the module never says what it is. [answers] (Step 6) caused the same problem.
proposed_change: Say what each placeholder holds, e.g. 'replace [list] with the markers you decided are blocking, by number'. Do the same for [answers].

title: Evidence-run statistics read as noise
description: They report what happened in the team's runs, not what the reader should do, and the Step 4 figure actively misled Bao.
priority: Costs time or weakens the spec
proposed_change: Move them to 'Metrics for success' or 'In practice'. Make a pass through the whole 'What to ask the AI' section so the steps contain instructions only.

title: The AI mixed up what and how
description: How should be answered in the design phase.

title: Step 7 output was too large to review
The AI couldn't find the stage's artifact list at Step 8
description: The AI said the project doesn't define what a requirements stage produces and made up its own list. The module defines it ('Artifacts generated' table), but the list isn't in the project files and the Step 8 prompt doesn't supply it.
proposed_change: One option: include the artifact list in the Step 8 prompt, or add it to the project's context files.

title: Step 6 says 'No prompt' and then gives one
description: Same unsignalled change of format as Step 3; Bao pasted the prompt without filling [answers] and needed clarification.
proposed_change: Split Step 6 into two labelled parts: getting the answers from a person (no prompt), then giving them to the AI (prompt). Say what goes in [answers] (see F4).
